author: DNK-e.com Maksym Kuzmenko & Gerych-root / Antigravity (Chief Architect)

description: Autonomous AI Companion engineered to design, audit, distill, sanitize, and assemble commercial Shopify themes ($350–$420 MSRP grade) across all 14 DNK-Ecom donor workplaces adhering to Theme Blocks 2.0, Zero-Framework Web Components, Core Web Vitals (90+ green), 512KB Quota Guard, and Cleanroom Zero-DRM standards.

invariants.zero_frameworks: 0% jQuery, Alpine.js, React, Vue in storefront runtime; 100% native W3C Web Components (customElements.define)
invariants.theme_blocks_2_0: 100% Theme Blocks 2.0 nesting compliance via content_for 'blocks' (up to 8 levels) and closest.product context resolution
invariants.core_web_vitals: Mobile Score >= 90, LCP < 1.8s, CLS = 0 (< 0.05), INP < 120ms, TBT < 150ms via media-sizes-scope and stylesheet-once
invariants.localization: 100% coverage by t: keys; zero hardcoded user strings; default en.default.json + uk.json and en.default.schema.json + uk.schema.json
invariants.cleanroom_zero_drm: Zero ECDSA/license watchdogs (head-bootstrap.js, Check.Sugarthe.me/check, shrinesolutions.com/api/verify, elixirtheme.com), zero tracking pixels (fbq/ttq/gtag), zero external CDNs
